60101: Capital of Styria, on the Mur River where it leaves the Alps for the Graz Basin.

40101: Capital of Upper Austria on the Danube, about 30 km south of the Czech border.

50101: Lies on the Salzach River at the foot of the Alps, near the German border.

20101: Capital of Carinthia, in the Klagenfurt Basin on Lake Wörthersee.

40301: City in Upper Austria on the Traun River, near Linz.

30201: Capital of Lower Austria, on the Traisen River in the Alpenvorland.

80301: Largest city in Vorarlberg, an administrative and commercial centre in the north of the state.

30401: City in Lower Austria's Industrieviertel, about 50 km south of Vienna.

40201: City in Upper Austria at the confluence of the Enns and Steyr rivers.

80404: Westernmost municipality in Austria, bordering both Switzerland and Liechtenstein on the Rhine.

80207: Capital of Vorarlberg, on the eastern shore of Lake Constance at the foot of the Pfänder.

30604: Spa town about 26 km south of Vienna on the Thermenlinie.

30101: City on the Danube about 70 km west of Vienna.

41021: Town in Upper Austria on the Traun River, bordering Linz.

20923: Town in Carinthia's Lavant valley, capital of Wolfsberg District.
80303: Town in Vorarlberg on the Rhine, which forms the border with Switzerland; Austria's most populous market town.

30502: City in Lower Austria, capital of Amstetten District.

30740: City southeast of Vienna, home to Vienna International Airport and OMV's largest oil refinery in Austria.

31717: Town about 15 km south of Vienna in the Industrieviertel, on the edge of the Vienna Woods.

70513: Second-largest town in Tyrol after Innsbruck, on the border with Bavaria.

30639: Town in Lower Austria's Thermenlinie wine region, about 20 km south of Vienna.

41002: Town in Upper Austria on the Traun and Krems rivers, near Linz.

40404: Town in Upper Austria's Innviertel region, on the River Inn at the border with Bavaria.

31230: Town in the Weinviertel region of Lower Austria, the largest town in that wine-growing area.

50619: Town in the Pinzgau region of Salzburg, centre of the Saalach valley near the Steinernes Meer massif.

32135: Historic town on the Danube in Lower Austria, seat of Tulln District.

70357: Market town in Tyrol's Innsbruck-Land district, about 27 km west of Innsbruck.

20635: Town in western Carinthia, administrative centre of Austria's second-largest district by area.

80103: Town in Vorarlberg, administrative seat of Bludenz District.

41812: Town in Upper Austria's Hausruckviertel, in the district of Wels-Land.

31719: Market town in the Mödling district of Lower Austria, just south of Vienna.

31839: Town in Lower Austria in the district of Neunkirchen.

70354: Town in Tyrol's Inn valley, about 5 km east of Innsbruck.

70926: City in Tyrol's lower Inn valley.

21002: Town in Carinthia, capital of the district of the same name; its name means "the church in the fields".

50338: Municipality near the city of Salzburg, formed in 1948 from the merger of Wals and Siezenheim.

70531: City in Tyrol's Inn valley, about 20 km from the Bavarian border.

40703: Spa town in the Salzkammergut region of Upper Austria, at the confluence of the Traun and Ischl rivers.

80215: Town in Vorarlberg directly on the southern shore of Lake Constance.

31213: Town in the Weinviertel of Lower Austria, on the Danube about 12 km northwest of Vienna, known for Grüner Veltliner and Zweigelt wines.

61053: City in Styria between the Mur and Sulm rivers, south of Graz.

62379: Town in southeastern Styria near the Slovenian and Hungarian borders.

40705: Town in Upper Austria's Salzkammergut, on the northern shore of Lake Traunsee.

41746: Town in Upper Austria's Hausruckviertel, centre of the Vöckla-Ager economic area.

31818: Town in Lower Austria, capital of the district of Neunkirchen.

41225: Town in western Upper Austria's Innviertel, about 70 km west of Linz; capital of Ried im Innkreis district.

62041: City in Styria on the Mur river, a former railway town.

60664: Market town in Styria's Graz-Umgebung district, just northwest of Graz.

30603: Spa town in the Baden district of Lower Austria's Industrieviertel.

31022: District capital town in Lower Austria on the Göllersbach river, at the heart of the Weinviertel wine region.

80408: Market town in Vorarlberg's Alpine Rhine valley, in the district of Feldkirch.

30817: Town on the Marchfeld plain in Lower Austria, about 20 km northeast of Vienna.

30856: Satellite town 25 km east of Vienna, on the Northern Railway line.

31704: Town in the Mödling district of Lower Austria, just south of Vienna's city border, part of the capital's agglomeration.

60669: Municipality in Styria's Graz-Umgebung district, just south of Graz.

61766: Town in eastern Styria, capital of Weiz district.

41005: Town in Upper Austria on the river Enns, which forms the border with Lower Austria.

20527: Town in Carinthia at a crossroads of old trade routes, serving as the duchy's capital until 1518.

80414: Market town in Vorarlberg's Feldkirch district, the second-largest in that district.

30821: Town east of Vienna and north of the Danube, in the district of Gänserndorf.

31235: Town in the Korneuburg district of Lower Austria.

70716: Medieval town in Tyrol at the confluence of the Isel and Drau rivers, administrative centre of East Tyrol.

30607: Town in the Baden district of Lower Austria's Industrieviertel.

31633: Town in northeastern Lower Austria, about 40 km from Vienna; capital of Mistelbach district.

50339: Town on Lake Wallersee in the Flachgau region of Salzburg, opposite Neumarkt am Wallersee.

60344: Town in southern Styria near the Slovenian border, about 35 km from Graz.

50418: City in the Pongau region of Salzburg, administrative centre of its namesake district.

61760: Town in eastern Styria's Weiz district, about 21 km east of Graz.

70203: Town in western Tyrol on the River Inn, about 50 km west of Innsbruck.

30301: Statutory city in Lower Austria, first mentioned in 1186 and economic centre of the Ybbstal region since the 14th century.
Long shaped by centuries of iron processing.
61120: Town in Upper Styria's Leoben district, site of a British-sector displaced-persons camp after the Second World War.

50404: Town in Salzburg's Pongau region, about 50 km south of the city of Salzburg.

20817: Town in Carinthia's Drava valley, east of Klagenfurt and north of the Karawanken mountain range.

32530: Town and district capital in northwestern Lower Austria, known chiefly for Zwettl Abbey, first mentioned in 1139.

80224: Municipality in Vorarlberg's Bregenz district, in the northern Rhine valley between Bregenz and Dornbirn.

50628: Town on Lake Zell in Salzburg's Kitzbühel Alps, administrative centre of Zell am See district.

40701: Market town on the western shore of Lake Traunsee in Upper Austria, about 3 km south of Gmunden.

31952: Town in the Vienna Woods on the edge of Vienna, in the St. Pölten-Land district of Lower Austria.

41516: Market town in the Steyr-Land district of Upper Austria.

70416: Market municipality in Tyrol's Kitzbühel district, locally called Sainihåns in dialect.

20913: Town in Carinthia's Lavant valley, in the Wolfsberg district.

40711: Municipality in the Gmunden district of Upper Austria.

31725: Town in the Mödling district of Lower Austria's Industrieviertel, near Vienna.

20711: Market town on Lake Faak in Carinthia's Villach-Land district.

61631: Small city in Styria at the foot of the Stubalpe mountain, in the Voitsberg district.

61625: Small city in western Styria's Voitsberg district, which grew around a church on the Tregistbach, first mentioned in 1220.
